skills.name: build-outreach-lists
skills.description: Build and enrich campaign-ready Bigmind account-outreach Lists by selecting target accounts, creating the account-outreach template, adding account rows and targetable people, researching company context, prioritizing prospects, and drafting personalized outreach. Use for target-account lists, prospect research, re-engagement lists, stakeholder selection, account theses, and outreach planning or copy—not campaign launch or message sending.
skills.description_zh: 在 Bigmind 建立并丰富可用于营销活动的目标账户触达名单，选择账户和人员、创建模板与行、调查公司、排序潜客并起草个性化文案；不用于启动活动或发送消息。

skills.name: configure-conversation-intelligence
skills.description: Configure Bigmind conversation intelligence and coaching resources, including competition, product-feedback, keyword, and concept trackers; meeting categories; custom vocabulary; frameworks; scorecards and questions; talking points; and coaching simulations. Use when a user asks to create, inspect, update, activate, publish, or organize how Bigmind analyzes and coaches conversations.
skills.description_zh: 配置 Bigmind 对话智能及辅导资源，包括竞品、产品反馈、关键词和概念跟踪器、会议类别、自定义词汇、框架、评分卡问题、谈话要点与模拟训练；支持检查、更新、激活、发布和组织。

skills.name: meeting-workflows
skills.description: Prepare for upcoming customer meetings, review past calls, recover account or contact conversation history, summarize transcripts and notes, identify decisions and commitments, and create requested follow-up tasks or CRM notes using Bigmind. Use for meeting preparation, call recaps, meeting summaries, action items, next steps, and post-meeting follow-up.
skills.description_zh: 使用 Bigmind 准备客户会议、回顾通话、找回账户或联系人的对话历史、概括转录与笔记，提取决策承诺，并按要求创建跟进任务或 CRM 笔记。

skills.name: review-revenue
skills.description: Research accounts and stakeholders, assess deal and renewal risk, review individual or team pipeline, interpret account signals, prioritize opportunities, and synthesize win-loss, competitive, product-feedback, engagement, and revenue patterns using Bigmind. Use for account reviews, pipeline inspection, deal risk, churn or renewal analysis, sales leadership questions, and evidence-grounded revenue intelligence.
skills.description_zh: 使用 Bigmind 调查账户与利益相关者、评估交易及续约风险、检查个人或团队销售管线、解释账户信号和排序机会，综合赢单丢单、竞争、反馈、互动和收入模式，形成有证据的销售洞察。
